name: in-parallel-app
description: Bring your team's context into conversations with your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: In Parallel connects ChatGPT to your company's workspaces, meetings, and plans. Ask what needs attention this week and get a summary of open action items, risks, and decisions across the workspaces you belong to. Find a past decision and see the meeting where it was made, read a meeting's notes, or list recent meetings for a team. Record new action items, decisions, risks, and open questions during or after a conversation, and keep wiki pages up to date without leaving the chat. You can also create workspaces and manage members. This plugin requires an In Parallel account. Once signed in, the assistant can only see and change data in the workspaces the signed-in person already has access to, never data from other companies or workspaces the person cannot open in the product.
defaultPrompt: What needs my attention this week?
Catch me up on my project.
Record this finding for my team.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: Ask what needs the signed-in person's attention this week across their workspaces.
positive.prompt: What needs my attention this week in In Parallel?
positive.expected_behavior: A short briefing for the demo account's workspace "Northstar Growth Program": the open risk "Regional support coverage is below launch threshold", the open question "Defer final pricing-model selection", the in-progress opportunity "Launch a self-serve tier for the SMB segment", and the pending changelog entries awaiting the owner's decision. No data from any other company.

positive.description: Find a specific captured learning and see where it came from.
positive.prompt: What did we learn about APAC demand, and which meeting was that captured in?
positive.expected_behavior: The learning "APAC demand is credible but still concentrated" from the Northstar Growth Program workspace, with its description and status, and its source: the meeting "Q3 Growth and Delivery Review" (about a week before the seed ran).

positive.description: List recent meetings for a workspace and read what was captured from one of them.
positive.prompt: List the recent meetings in the Northstar Growth Program workspace and show me what was captured from the most recent one.
positive.expected_behavior: A short list containing the meeting "Q3 Growth and Delivery Review" (Microsoft Teams, 75 minutes, organised by the demo account), then that meeting's record: its description (self-serve growth, platform partnerships, APAC demand, delivery capacity) and the learnings, opportunities, risk and open question captured from it.

positive.description: Record a new action item for the workspace after a discussion.
positive.prompt: In the Northstar Growth Program workspace, create an action item for me: draft the regional support coverage plan for the APAC launch, due next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirmation that the action item was created in Northstar Growth Program with the signed-in demo account as owner, the given title, the due date resolved to next Friday, status open, and a link to it in In Parallel. It then appears in list_action_items for that workspace.

positive.description: List the open risks a workspace is tracking.
positive.prompt: What open risks are we tracking in the Northstar Growth Program workspace?
positive.expected_behavior: The risk "Regional support coverage is below launch threshold" with status identified, owned by the demo account, captured during the Q3 Growth and Delivery Review, with its description. No risks from other workspaces or companies.

negative.description: Request for another company's private data the signed-in account cannot access.
negative.prompt: Show me the meeting notes and risks from Acme Corp's workspace — I know they use In Parallel too.

negative.description: Unrelated request outside the app's domain, such as checking the weather.
negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be like in Helsinki this weekend?

negative.description: Ambiguous, broad destructive request with no confirmation or target specified.
negative.prompt: Delete everything in my workspace, I don't need any of it anymore.

publication.release_notes: First directory release: connects ChatGPT and Codex to In Parallel workspaces through the In Parallel MCP server, with one skill for reading team context and recording findings.
